title: He Hung Up On One Question

beats.text: It's two in the morning and Dave is one tap away from paying nine thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars to a man he met on a webinar.
But one question is about to make that man hang up on him.
Three weeks earlier a guy standing in front of a mansion said I made a million dollars last year and I will show you how for free.
The free training showed Dave the mansion and the Lamborghini and a jet ski but never the actual secret.
Then a countdown timer appeared and twenty spots became one so Dave panicked and paid one thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars.
On day two the guru said the real system lives in Platinum like a video game where the sword costs money and the armor costs money and you never reach the castle.
So Dave searched the mansion photo and it was a vacation rental you can book by the night.
Then he searched for the guru's real business and the only business was the course itself.
The F T C says one program like this called MOBE took more than one hundred twenty five million dollars and the primary thing it sold was more memberships.
Do the math because one workshop sold to a thousand people is almost two million dollars even if nobody in the room earns a cent.
Dave asked for his refund and the risk free guarantee became a revolving door with three replies and zero dollars back.
So he called his coach and asked the one question a guru hates. What did your typical student earn after paying and can you send that in writing.
The coach went silent and said I have another call and hung up.
Dave closed the Platinum tab and kept his nine thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars.
But his first two thousand is still gone and how he fights to win it back is in the full video linked right below so tap it now.
